summary: Iteration 20: Compliance Features Phase 1 Testing - Mobile Navigation, Privacy/Terms Pages, Reports API, Data Export, Delete Account. Backend: 15/15 tests PASSED. Frontend: All features verified working.

issues: Tour modal appears on top of delete account page (minor UX issue - could be dismissed)

critical_code_review_comments: Mobile Navigation: Instagram-style bottom nav with 5 icons (Inicio, Reels, Crear, Mapa, Perfil) working correctly on mobile viewports (<768px)
Mobile Nav Hidden on Desktop: Correctly hidden using md:hidden CSS class on viewports >= 768px
Privacy Policy Page (/privacy): Public access working, all 8 sections present including GDPR/CCPA compliance notice
Terms of Service Page (/terms): Public access working, all 7+ sections present including prohibited content policy
Delete Account Page (/settings/delete-account): Protected route, shows warning banner, export data option, step-by-step deletion process
Reports API (POST /api/reports): Working for all content types (post, user, comment, product) with various reasons (spam, harassment, hate_speech, violence, etc.)
Data Export API (GET /api/profile/export): Returns full user data export with cards, posts, products, stories, messages, points_history, reports_submitted
Delete Account API (DELETE /api/profile/delete-account): Validates confirmation text, deletes/anonymizes all user data
Leaflet Map (/map): Real OpenStreetMap tiles loading correctly (48 tiles), attribution shows 'Leaflet | © OpenStreetMap'
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ reports during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 verified all Phase 1 Compliance features: 1) Mobile bottom navigation shows 5 icons on mobile (<768px) and hidden on desktop. 2) Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages are PUBLIC (no login required). 3) Delete Account page is PROTECTED (requires login) and shows export data option. 4) Reports API works for all content types and reasons. 5) Data Export API returns complete user data. 6) Delete Account API validates confirmation text and password before deletion. 7) Map uses real Leaflet with OpenStreetMap tiles.
